# American Airlines and Israir Airlines to partner on travel between Israel and the US


[(English) (opens in new window) PDF 82 KB](https://s202.q4cdn.com/986123435/files/doc_news/American-Airlines-and-Israir-Airlines-to-partner-on-travel-between-Israel-and-the-US-NET-ALP-11-2026.pdf)


FORT WORTH, Texas and TEL AVIV, Israel — American Airlines and Israir Airlines have signed an agreement to create a new commercial partnership focused on enhanced travel options between Israel and the United States. The partnership will expand in phases and deliver benefits for customers ahead of American’s planned return to Tel Aviv (TLV) in 2027.


“American looks forward to building a relationship with Israir that will give customers the convenient, well-connected travel options they desire,” said American’s Senior Vice President of Alliances Anmol Bhargava. “As we prepare to resume service between New York and Tel Aviv next spring, this partnership will help us deliver a stronger customer proposition in the market and create more opportunities for Israir’s travelers to connect beyond our JFK gateway.”


Under the initial phase of the partnership, Isair expects to place its code on American’s nonstop flights between New York John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK) and TLV. Moreover, the two carriers will work to implement an interline agreement giving Israir customers access to American’s network across the United States, Canada, Latin America and the Caribbean from JFK. This will enable Israir customers to connect from either American or Israir-operated flights between JFK and TLV to onward points served by American from JFK.


"We are both humbled and privileged to embark on this strategic partnership with American Airlines, one of the world's leading carriers. This cooperation marks a significant milestone for Israir and for the traveling public in Israel,” said Israir’s Chief Executive Officer Uri Sirkis. “By combining American's extensive global network with Israir's strong position in the Israeli market, we will be able to offer our customers greater connectivity, enhanced travel experiences, and seamless access to destinations across North America and beyond. We are confident that this partnership will continue to grow over time and create additional products, services and opportunities for our joint customers."


Following the initial phase, the airlines will examine opportunities to expand the codeshare agreement and deliver additional travel benefits for AAdvantage® members.


American plans to resume daily service between JFK and TLV starting March 27, 2027, with Boeing 777-200ER aircraft. Israir operates five weekly flights between JFK and TLV with Airbus A330-200 aircraft. Both carriers offer lie-flat premium products, and customers flying in American’s Flagship® Business class or Israir’s Business class can access The Greenwich Lounge™ experience at JFK, which offers chef-inspired meals, premium wine, showers and a relaxing atmosphere.


###### About American Airlines Group (NASDAQ: AAL)


American Airlines is a premium global airline connecting more of the U.S. to the world. With roots tracing back to an air mail carrier in the Midwestern United States in 1926, American now operates more than 6,000 daily flights to more than 350 destinations in more than 60 countries and serves more than 200 million customers annually. Powered by a proud and talented team of 130,000 aviation professionals, American’s team lives out the airline’s purpose of caring for people on life’s journey every day.


The world’s largest airline proudly celebrates its centennial year in 2026, reaching a milestone that reflects a century of innovation and the Forever Forward℠ spirit that changed the industry and the world. American introduced the first scheduled air cargo service, the first airport lounge and the first airline loyalty program and continues to reinvent the customer experience today. The airline is also a founding member of the **one** world alliance, whose members serve more than 900 destinations around the globe.


Get the latest about American at[news.aa.com](https://news.aa.com/) and[@AmericanAir](https://x.com/AmericanAir) .


###### About Israir Airlines


Israir Airlines is one of Israel's leading airlines, providing domestic and international air services and connecting Israel with key leisure and business destinations.
